transcript: Stop pretending you know how to use Claude. Give me 60 seconds and I can guarantee you, you'll know more than 99.9% of people in AI. There are eight layers of using Claude. Layer one is basic chat. You type in questions, get answers, simple basic stuff. Layer two is memory. Claude remembers who you are, your business, your preferences, across every conversation. The more you use it, the smarter it gets about you. It can even pull information from past chats for a specific case. Layer three, projects. You can upload files and custom instructions and now Claude has permanent context about your business or a job. Every conversation you have stays inside a folder with a specific context. Layer four, skills. Think of it like hiring a domain expert. Skills teach Claude how to do things. You just have to build them once and you can call that domain expert/employee whenever you want. Layer five, artifacts. This is where things starts to get super interesting. Claude stops giving text and starts giving deliverables. Interactive apps, dashboards, full documents built and previewable right inside the chat. And you can even publish them on the mini app store. Layer six, connectors. Claude connects with your actual tools using MCP server. Canva, Figma, Gmail, Drive, Slack, any third party app you can find. It starts pulling your real data from these third party apps and tools to execute tasks. Layer seven, and this is my favorite, plugins. It's like a whole package. It has skills, connectors and instructions. For example, you don't have to do a data analyst stuff by prompting. You install one plug-in and Claude shows up as an employee. Ready to execute tasks at expert level. Layer eight, Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Cowork is basically Claude Code, but for non-developers. It can access your actual files from your computer and run tasks while you sleep. For developers, you can access full terminal, perform agentic coding, build entire system. Like this is the top. Most people never get past layer one, but now you know all eight. So follow me for more.
caption: Claude has features 99% of users don’t even know exist. This is the only video you need to go from beginner to pro. Thank me later!! :)
